candidateOccurrences.sourceText: Moses gave an inheritance to the half-tribe of Manasseh. It was for the half-tribe of the children of Manasseh according to their families.
candidateOccurrences.previousContext: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad according to their families, the cities and its villages.
candidateOccurrences.nextContext: Their border was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the villages of Jair, which are in Bashan, sixty cities.
candidateOccurrences.relationshipNoteJa: WEBはマナセの半部族への相続地と明記。直前の13:8は東岸割当を述べるが「東マナセ」の呼称は編集上の地域名で、本文語句そのものではない。

candidateOccurrences.sourceText: Their border was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the villages of Jair, which are in Bashan, sixty cities.

candidateOccurrences.nextContext: Half Gilead, Ashtaroth, and Edrei, the cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were for the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, even for the half of the children of Machir according to their families.
